source_issue.title: Trigger 6-dev documentation build on every push to master in Volto

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the need to automatically trigger the documentation build for Volto whenever a push occurs to the master branch. Currently, there are challenges in achieving this, and the process is not straightforward.

## What needs to be done
The main task is to set up a system that ensures the documentation builds with each master push. This may involve using CI/CD tools (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) and configuring scripts correctly.

## Helpful background
Previous discussions have highlighted potential approaches but also pointed out difficulties in implementation. For more context, you can refer to related issues [#1188](https://github.com/plone/documentation/issues/1188) and [#1214](https://github.com/plone/documentation/issues/1214). As of now, there doesn’t seem to be a clear, functional way to resolve this issue.

## Good first steps
1. Review existing CI/CD setups in the repository.
2. Familiarize yourself with current documentation build processes.
3. Collaborate with the assignee, @esteele, for guidance and clarification on technical hurdles encountered previously.
4. Contribute to discussions on potential solutions or improvements.
5. Consider documenting your findings or potential steps forward for future reference.
```
